name: @calchemy/date-react
description: Headless React primitives for Calchemy date input.

scripts.build: tsup src/index.ts src/calendar-scroll.ts --format esm --sourcemap --tsconfig tsconfig.build.json --external react --external react-dom --external react/jsx-runtime --external @calchemy/date-core && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --emitDeclarationOnly
scripts.test: pnpm run build && vitest run --root ../.. --config vitest.config.ts packages/date-react/tests --environment jsdom
